context: TagInput renders one text input per tag so users can rename tags inline, plus a draft input for adding new ones.
explanation: The list key was changed from the stable tag.id to Math.random(), which generates a new value on every single render. React treats each row as a brand-new element whenever this happens, unmounting and remounting every input — so the DOM node holding focus is destroyed on every keystroke, and users lose focus after typing just one character. Fix: use the stable tag.id as the key.
